answer_text:
1. The survey analyzes over 1400 research papers.
2. LongRoPE achieves a 2048K token context window through a two-stage approach (first fine-tuning models to 256K length, then conducting positional interpolation).
3. GPT-4 achieves approximately 20% absolute performance improvement through the Self-Refine methodology.
4. Humans achieve 92% accuracy on general assistant tasks, while advanced models like GPT-4 achieve 15% accuracy.
5. The four categories of System Implementations are: 1) Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), 2) Memory Systems, 3) Tool-Integrated Reasoning, and 4) Multi-Agent Systems.
